arguments.command:
python3 -c "
values = [366, 436, 124, 63, 153, 91, 379, 406, 269, 248, 145, 21]
sorted_values = sorted(values)
print('Sorted values:', sorted_values)
print('Number of values:', len(sorted_values))

# Median calculation for 12 values (even)
# Median is average of 6th and 7th values (0-indexed: 5 and 6)
median = (sorted_values[5] + sorted_values[6]) / 2
print('6th value:', sorted_values[5])
print('7th value:', sorted_values[6])
print('Median:', median)

# FY 1974 value
fy_1974 = 21
print('FY 1974 value:', fy_1974)

# Signed deviation
deviation = fy_1974 - median
print('Signed deviation:', deviation)
print('Rounded to 1 decimal:', round(deviation, 1))
"
